proposals.title: Extended Context Unlock
proposals.oneLiner: Watch a quick game partner session to unlock 1 hour of 5x extended context memory.
proposals.trigger: When the user hits the memory wall trying to continue a long chat without Janitor Plus.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying free users hitting the memory context limit.

offer.title: Unlock Memory Boost
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to get 1 hour of context memory.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Time-boxed to 1 hour, rate-limited to 3 times per day, and gated to non-payers only; Janitor Plus subscription remains the permanent, un-interrupted option.

kpis.primary: Rewarded ad ARPDAU and total ad revenue
guardrails: Janitor Plus subscription conversion non-inferiority within -3%
D7 and D30 user retention stability
Session length and chat engagement stability
kpis.holdout: A 10% user-level randomized holdout running for 28 days to measure net ARPU impact.

risks: Temporary memory unlock may slightly reduce immediate paywall views if overused
Requires stable rewarded ad fill rates in chat utility flows

proposals.title: Daily Character Quest Hub
proposals.oneLiner: Earn daily check-in rewards and frontier model swipes by completing character quests via rewarded mini-games.

newMechanic.name: Daily Character Quest Hub
newMechanic.description: A proactive hub on the profile screen where users complete daily tasks and check-ins with characters to earn frontier swipe credits.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Janitor Plus gating frontier swipes leaves non-payers with limited access; a proactive quest hub creates predictable, non-interruptive rewarded inventory.

proposals.trigger: When the user views their profile and taps the new daily quest hub entry after onboarding.

offer.title: Unlock Free Frontier Swipes
offer.body: Play a 15-second mini-game with Janitor AI to claim your daily check-in reward.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Restricted to non-payers, capped at 3 daily completions, and sized well below Janitor Plus monthly entitlements.

kpis.primary: Rewarded ad ARPDAU and daily active engagement rate
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% holdout test running for 28 days.

risks: Low risk of subscription cannibalization if daily rewards remain modest compared to Janitor Plus benefits.
Ad fill rates in non-US regions.

newScreens.change: Add a Daily Character Quest Hub section to the profile screen.

storyboard.caption: Profile shows subscription upsell with no free daily reward option.
Add a proactive Daily Character Quest Hub to the profile.
User taps quest and sees clear opt-in disclosure.
User plays the 15-second mini-game with Game Partner.
Reward verified and credited instantly to user account.

scenario.label: Scenario, not a forecast: 25% of DAU engage, 1.5 views each, US mid eCPM after a 25% non-game haircut.

flags: Cost to serve the reward ($0.0090) exceeds net revenue per view ($0.0063) at the low end.

proposals.title: Subscription Feature Sampling via Rewarded Ad
proposals.oneLiner: Offer a 1-hour trial of Janitor Plus when users dismiss the paywall after a rewarded mini-game.

newMechanic.name: Paywall-Decline Trial Pass
newMechanic.description: A 1-hour time-boxed trial of Janitor Plus features offered to free users immediately upon declining the subscription paywall.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Provides an accessible sampling path for price-sensitive users who decline the upfront subscription paywall, converting attention into upgrade intent.

proposals.trigger: When a free user taps 'Not now' to dismiss the Janitor Plus paywall (moment m3).
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying free users who dismiss the subscription paywall, capped at once per day.

offer.title: Try Janitor Plus Free
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to unlock 1 hour of premium memory.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Gated strictly to users who decline the paywall; time-boxed to 1 hour; permanently distinct from full monthly subscription entitlement.

kpis.primary: Rewarded ARPDAU and subscription conversion rate among paywall decliners
kpis.holdout: 20% user-level randomized holdout running for 28 days to measure net revenue impact.

risks: Risk of temporary cannibalization if trial duration is too long
Potential ad fill variations across international regions

newScreens.change: Trial offer confirmation modal shown upon tapping 'Not now' on the Janitor Plus paywall.

newElements.change: Button inviting user to watch a rewarded mini-game for a 1-hour trial.

storyboard.caption: User declines the Janitor Plus subscription paywall.
App introduces a rewarded sampling offer upon paywall decline.
User sees clear opt-in prompt with working decline.
User completes the voluntary 15-second rewarded mini-game.
Reward verified and 1-hour trial unlocked successfully.
